kind: Private development dogfood; not a public benchmark or controlled performance comparison

protocol.prompt: Build a complete dependency-free Node.js room-reservation application with store.cjs, a separate interval/validation helper module, cli.cjs, package.json and README.md. Export openStore(file) from store.cjs. It returns synchronous reserve(booking), cancel(id) and list(filter={}) methods. A booking is exactly {id,room,start,end}; id and room must be nonblank strings and times nonnegative safe integers with start<end. Invalid bookings throw Error with code VALIDATION. Same id and identical fields is idempotent and returns a defensive copy; same id different fields throws DUPLICATE. Overlapping half-open [start,end) intervals in the same room throw CONFLICT; adjacent intervals and other rooms are allowed. list returns defensive copies sorted by start then id, with optional room and overlapping {from,to} filters. cancel returns a boolean. Persist successful mutations atomically to JSON {version:1,bookings:[...]}; reopen must retain data. Failed mutations must leave the database unchanged. Malformed/corrupt persisted data must throw without overwriting it. Use prototype-safe identifiers. Do not mutate input objects. CLI: node cli.cjs --db file reserve JSON, list [JSON-filter], cancel id. Print only result JSON on stdout on success; cancellation returns {cancelled:boolean}. Errors and unknown commands exit nonzero with meaningful stderr and no stdout. README must explain usage and constraints. Read acceptance.cjs for the original external contract; do not modify it or create substitute tests. Implement all features, run node acceptance.cjs, repair actual failures and verify the finished application. No external services or web research.

limitations: One free-mode run per version; model/provider variation prevents causal performance claims.
The acceptance checks cover application behaviour but only README presence/length. Candidate README has usage examples but omits requested constraint documentation.
Candidate model build preceded a later recap-only fix; that fix has its own regression tests.
No manual code repairs or acceptance changes.
fixes: Reserve existing parent model calls for integration/repair, without raising the shared call cap.
Scope self-contained HTML recovery to owned scratch files; retain pre-existing user files and fail closed on validation exceptions.
Report current local verification evidence instead of replaying tool calls or stale unfinished prose.
